build_PackTag: build a protobuf wire tag by encoding field number and wire type into a 32-bit integer
build_UnpackTag: build a field number and wire type tuple by decoding a protobuf wire tag integer
build_ZigZagEncode: build a zigzag encoded unsigned integer from a signed integer for efficient varint serialization
build_ZigZagDecode: build a signed integer by decoding a zigzag encoded varint value back to its original form
build_IsTypePackable: build a check to determine if a protobuf field type supports packed repeated field encoding
